stem: Which map shows the boundaries of the United States just after the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo?

options.label: A
options.text: Map with United States, Foreign territory, and Disputed area keyed; western part shaded as Foreign territory and Disputed area.

options.label: B
options.text: Map with United States, Foreign territory, and Disputed area keyed; western part shaded mostly as Foreign territory.

options.label: C
options.text: Map with United States and Foreign territory keyed; western part mixed but not showing Disputed area.

options.label: D
options.text: Map showing only United States with all states shaded as such.

visual_elements: Four maps labeled A, B, C, D showing different boundary demarcations of the United States.
Each map includes a compass rose for orientation (N, W, E, S).
Legends with key for United States, Foreign territory, and Disputed area as applicable.
notes: Wording and math preserved exactly; map details summarized for options as text due to visual nature.
